ai_summary: Alivus Life Sciences is acquiring a 76% majority stake in IQGenX Pharma Private Limited for INR 91.2 million, strategically expanding its core API business into advanced formulation development and creating an integrated end-to-end platform. This acquisition significantly broadens Alivus's CDMO services, extends its global market reach for generic pharmaceuticals, and aims to develop niche assets for out-licensing. While the strategic rationale for vertical integration is clear, the document lacks financial details on IQGenX's performance, preventing a comprehensive assessment of the acquisition's valuation or direct financial impact.
